items.title: Math's mathing. #Cavs have allowed a lot inside, but have held the Wizards to 6 of 18 from long range. Cleveland, on the flip side, has made 11 of 26 from deep. This is an 87-86 game with 3:17 left in the third, much in part to Jaylon Tyson & Sam Merrill drilling three triples.
